description: Evaluate one candidate. starts=dev: the 15 open development starts (same starts for every candidate, so results pair up; counts one development evaluation). starts=train: N fresh random training starts (counts N training episodes). Returns success, termination reasons, per-start outcomes and diagnostics (per object: lifted / moved; touched; episode length) split by success and failure. On training starts a program also gets real_time: its per-step compute estimated for the real-robot station worker (CPU fk / ik, ~1.5 ms per ik point; budget ~100 ms per step). A program with steps over budget stalls or is stopped on the robot (11-13: a place program solving ik for a whole path in one step).

costs.train: N training episodes, ~1 min per 16 episodes per 100 steps
